title: Owner returns with Back to Board View and the horizontal and column scroll positions are restored
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List, no layout keys)
Twelve work orders with no lead for a unique customer, each with a line, and the customer has no pinned note
More technician columns than fit the viewport

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View renders with the twelve cards in Unassigned

custom_steps_separated.content: Scroll the board sideways, and scroll the Unassigned column down
custom_steps_separated.expected: Note the first visible technician column and the first visible Unassigned card (neither is the first)
Board View renders, data-scroll-restore becomes "applied", and the first visible technician column and Unassigned card are the ones noted

custom_steps_separated.content: Open a visible card again, then open Work Orders from the header link
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Board View opens at top-left (no horizontal offset, Unassigned at its first card) with data-scroll-restore "none"

Back restores both scroll axes of Board View; a fresh navigation starts at the top-left
